senses.gloss:
1. धासि, इस्, f., Ved. a dwelling-place, seat, home;
(Sāy.) a holder, bearer, maintainer; food.

2. धासि, इस्, m. (for 1. धासि see p. 453, col. 3), Ved.
a milk-beverage, a drink; nourishment in general.

धास्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desirous of drinking or
of eating.
धासस् धासस्, आस्, m., Ved. a mountain.
